userDecisions.U3: Back up data/omniswim.db, list the 39 "UI ..." workspaces, delete only those via the app delete route. Do not kill the port-3000 server.
userDecisions.U4: Add relay programs only from a published, archived source; leave the rest absent; make relays-before-individual order a visible setting.
userDecisions.U5: Seed place-point tables empty; core returns null past the table end; a blank cell blocks save.
userDecisions.U6: Restore one-click All teams apply AND add a visible remove button (keep Delete/Backspace).
userDecisions.U7: Season trend shows the workspace own team by default, with a team picker; team absent from a meet gets no point.
